title: Ribbon Cutting: Vietti Marking Group
seo_title: Ribbon Cutting: Vietti Marking Group in Springfield, MO
description: A ribbon cutting for Vietti Marking Group takes place on Thursday, November 12, 2026, from 11:30 AM to 12:30 PM. It is held at 4650 South National Ave., Suite C7, in Springfield, MO. The Republic Area Chamber of Commerce is listed as the organizer.
